title: Herodotus takes part in the Egyptian mystery cults and then stays silent about them

tellings.quote: Heroditus talks about these mystery cults in Egypt and he speculates on like I wonder what's going on here and then while he's in Egypt he's allowed to participate in them and then he doesn't talk about it again.

plain: A researcher named Luke Caverns says that Herodotus, the ancient Greek historian of the 5th century BC, wrote about secret religious groups in Egypt known as mystery cults and wondered what went on inside them. According to Caverns, Herodotus was then allowed to take part in them while in Egypt and afterward never wrote about them again. He tells it to suggest the Egyptians held secrets so serious that even a famous writer kept quiet.
